note: Measured 2026-11-22 on one real hub, one metering plug (INSPELNING E2206, energy attributes on the outlet itself). The write was done with the owner's permission.

steps.step: read 3 s later (same values 5 s later)

reading: The hub copies the total into energyConsumedAtLastReset and sets the reset time to now; the total never resets. Usage since reset = totalEnergyConsumed - energyConsumedAtLastReset.
